name: X1 unreachable Cosmos FAILS OPEN (the gate opens when its verifier is down)
from: return deny('internal_error', 'cosmos unreachable: ' + (e && e.message ? e.message : e));

name: X2 ESCALATE becomes an ALLOW (a spend awaiting human approval is let through)
X3 an indivisible amount is silently ROUNDED instead of refused
from: return n % divisor === 0 ? n / divisor : null;

name: X4 the DENY stops carrying the signed receipt (the one slot evidence fits in)
from: if (body.receipt_id) { detail.cosmos_receipt_id = body.receipt_id; detail.cosmos_evidence = (cfg.publicUrl || cfg.url) + '/evidence/' + body.receipt_id; }
to: if (false) { detail.cosmos_receipt_id = body.receipt_id; detail.cosmos_evidence = (cfg.publicUrl || cfg.url) + '/evidence/' + body.receipt_id; }

name: X5 the ALLOW smuggles an extra key, breaking their closed schema
X6 a mapped code leaves the closed EVC registry (the host discards it)
X7 an unrecognised Cosmos decision falls through to an allow
from: return deny('internal_error', 'cosmos returned no recognisable decision');

name: X8 the CLI exits non-zero, so the host discards our code and receipt id
X9 a bundle with no currency/category is accepted and guessed at
from: return deny('invalid_bundle', 'bundle must carry currency and category; x402 context expresses neither');

name: X10 the new top-level directory stops being counted by the ceiling
X11 the evidence link goes back to a host-less relative path
X12 a reason loses its mapping and silently defaults
X13 the internal address is published instead of the public one
